description: Material announcements (重大訊息) of Taiwan-listed, OTC and emerging biotech/medical companies, collected hourly from the Market Observation Post System (公開資訊觀測站): subject, full text, clause, fact date, time. Primary source, no interpretation. Filter by company (name or ticker), keywords and days. Cite the company, date and subject (cite_as).

company.description: Company name or ticker, e.g. '台康生技' or '6589' (optional)

query.description: Keywords in subject or text, e.g. '授權', 'FDA', '臨床' (optional)
